fusions.name: Cadence Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the rod down, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Using it increases your movement speed by 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: End of the Road
fusions.desc: Brings the rod down for a blow that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. Its damage rises 5% for distance you have travelled (max 40%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Halt and Water
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Its effect increases by 8% for each ally within 5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Mile-Hardened
fusions.desc: Once you have covered enough ground, you gain a ward worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
